items.message: The `__init_subclass__` check fires at class-definition time for every subclass, including abstract or partially-declared intermediate base classes. If any internal base class (e.g., a per-verb base like `ImplementStrategy` mentioned in the docstring) is defined without `capabilities` set to `AGENCY`, it will raise `UndeclaredAgency` at import, potentially making the module unimportable.
